title: Install a Baseline Package Set (RHEL/Rocky and Debian, offline-repo aware)
description: Installs a list of packages, assuming your repos (local mirror, satellite, etc.) are already configured -- this never reaches the internet itself. The generic package module auto-detects dnf/yum vs apt per target host's facts (one playbook works across mixed-OS inventory); the os-specific option uses dnf/apt directly when you need finer control such as a cache refresh.

toggles.name: REFRESH_CACHE
toggles.prompt: Refresh the local repo metadata cache first (only used with the os-specific option; needs your offline repo mirror reachable, not the internet)

options.label: generic package module (auto-detects per host, works across mixed RHEL/Debian inventory)
explicit dnf/apt (needed for a cache refresh)
